principle: Move common math first; keep source sampling, region masks and tangent reconstruction in adapters.

functions.name: MF_WS_Grain
inputs: pre-skinned or undeformed local position cm
functions.preserve: Current triplanar projection and channel meanings.

functions.name: MF_WS_EdgeCavity
functions.preserve: First extraction preserves old math; separating geometric edge definition from exposed substrate is a later explicit revision.

functions.name: MF_WS_DryColorRoughness
functions.preserve: Color weights, markings and per-part roughness remain caller-owned.

functions.name: MF_WS_MetalAO
functions.preserve: Caller combines source AO once; do not infer material identity from a mesh name.

functions.name: MF_WS_WetBeads
functions.preserve: One weather driver; interiors and optics retain their coverage masks.

functions.name: MF_WS_WetFilm
functions.preserve: Retain current curve during extraction; per-family response coefficients are a separate future change.

functions.name: MF_WS_WetNormal
functions.preserve: Wetness follows source normal, seam reconstruction and bevel composition.

adapters_to_keep.name: A762
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: UV1 body mask, UV0 source atlas and accessory-specific masks; retain real geometry bevels.

adapters_to_keep.name: ASH12Regions
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: Vertex RGB material regions, polymer/bolt/bore overrides and bore wetness exclusion.

adapters_to_keep.name: ASH12Static
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: Static-only usage and authored normal tiling.

adapters_to_keep.name: ASH12ExtMag
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: Alternate UV1 samples and UV2-6 tangent seam matrices; no skeletal usage.

adapters_to_keep.name: SVDSource
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: Source metal mask, markings, polymer/rubber/cheekpad preservation, PSO exterior and original sampling.

adapters_to_keep.name: SVDRefine03
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: RNM bevel normal, local magazine ribs, dielectric remapping and per-part overrides.

adapters_to_keep.name: OpticalProtected
adapters_to_keep.responsibility: Keep glass, reticles, masked apertures and emissive mixed housings outside ordinary surface migration.

merge_rule: Shared functions do not prove graph equivalence. Do not merge source masters until their full sampling, regions, switches, usage and protected paths are accounted for.
